draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time. No rush on your end.

One thing that may help in the meantime: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a single project for whatever your team is working on now is usually enough to start. When you're ready for the team, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
